title: Rai na Farko da Ya Tsaya
intro: Tun kafin wani manzo ya yi tafiya a duniya, kafin a bayyana wani littafi, wani abu da ba kamar wani ba ya wanzuwa. An siffanta wannan rai da hannun Allah, an ba shi wuri mai kyau mara misaltuwa, kuma an gwada shi ta hanyar da zai yi ta maimaitawa a duk tarihin ɗan adam. Abin da ya biyo baya shi ne labarin rauni, tuba ta gaskiya, da kuma ƙaddara wadda za ta canza hanyar halitta har abada. Za ku iya tsammanin wanene wannan?
clues: An siffanta ni da hannun Mai rahama daga ƙurar ƙasa.
An ba ni gida mai kyau mara misaltuwa, inda babu yunwa ko gajiya da za ta taɓa ni
An umarce ni da kada in taɓa kusantar itace ɗaya, domin an haramta shi.
Ni da abokina mun yaudare mu muka kusanci bishiyar da aka haramta, ba tare da umarnin Ubangijinmu ba.
Mun koma ga Ubangijinmu da tuba ta gaskiya, kuma an gafarta mana laifinmu
Daga gare mu ne dukkan bil'adama suka fito; Ni ne farkon wanda ya yi tafiya a wannan duniya

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Jaraba ta wurin itacen da aka haramta
Hadayar ɗan da aka ƙaunace shi
Ana jefa shi cikin babbar wuta
trial.answer: Jaraba ta wurin itacen da aka haramta

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An saukar da shi duniya a matsayin mai kula da ɗan adam na farko
Fir'auna da rundunarsa sun nutse a cikin teku
Babban ambaliyar ruwa ta halaka miyagu
Wutar ta yi sanyi kuma ta yi natsuwa
An ba shi iko a kan masarautar Masar
outcome.answer: An saukar da shi duniya a matsayin mai kula da ɗan adam na farko

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
